title: herdr-agents board, version 1
description: ~/.herdr-agents/board/<session id>.json: what the Herdr app draws for one coordinator session, rewritten when it changes and at least once a minute, and removed when the session ends. An app acts on it by writing one action file (see $defs/action) into ~/.herdr-agents/board/<session id>.actions/; the mod does it within about 3 seconds, removes the file and reports the outcome in `actions`. Files there are taken in name order.

version.description: Bumped when a field changes meaning or goes away; new fields may appear without a bump.

at.description: When it was last written, ms since the epoch. Written when something else changed, and at least once a minute while the session lives, so a live board is newer than a leftover. The file also comes back within about one minute if deleted.

coordinator.description: Optional, so older boards stay valid.

terminal.description: The coordinator's hc terminal id (HC_TERMINAL_ID); null outside hc.

pane.description: Optional. The coordinator's herdr pane id (HERDR_PANE_ID); absent when unknown.

orchestrating.description: True once /hrd-orchestrate ran in this session (it starts workers), false while it works on its own; a finished /hrd-wrap-up clears it. Missing on older boards: unknown.

command.description: Like a worker's `command`, `commandAt` and `outputAt`: there only mid-turn.

turnAt.description: When the coordinator's turn started, to the minute; there only mid-turn.

tools.description: How many tools the coordinator has run this turn; there only mid-turn.

stageNames.description: The five stage columns, in order: plan, build, rev, CI, you.

needs.description: Open items waiting for the owner.

state.description: herdr's agent status (idle, working, blocked, done), or reported, waiting (on a WAIT.json check), or starting (its tab and CLI are being opened).

note.description: Why it stopped: what a waiting worker waits for, or what a blocked one is stuck on. Boards from before `since` start a waiting worker's note with its clock (`02:13 · PR checks`).

since.description: Optional, so older boards stay valid. When a waiting worker started waiting, ms since the epoch; a reader works the clock out from it, so the time passing never rewrites the file.

provider.description: Optional, so older boards stay valid. The CLI its profile runs: claude, codex, opencode.

model.description: Optional. The profile's model (`sonnet`, `opus`), from its `model` or its --model argument; missing when the profile names none.

worktree.description: Optional. The folder it works in.

branch.description: Optional. The git branch checked out there when it started.

pane.description: Optional. The herdr pane id of its terminal, as hc's spawn reply gave it; absent when hc gave none.

command.description: Optional, like the next two, and only on a working worker that runs this mod, mid-turn. The tool it has been running for 15 s or more: `npm test`.

commandAt.description: When that tool started, ms since the epoch.

outputAt.description: When the model last said anything or a tool last ended, ms since the epoch, rounded up to the minute. A reader works the clocks out from these, so the time passing never rewrites the file.

context.description: Optional, so older boards stay valid, and only for a worker that runs this mod. How full its context was after its last turn, in whole percent of the model's context window; absent when the window is unknown; drawn as `ctx 41%`.

diff.description: Optional, so older boards stay valid; absent when the branch changes nothing or git could not say. What the worker's committed branch changes against the repo's default branch (three dots, renames shown as a delete and an add), read at the PR poll's pace while the app mod draws.

base.description: The branch it is read against: main.

files.description: The first 30 changed files by path.

status.description: git's letter: A, M, D, T.

more.description: Changed files beyond the ones listed.

tasks.description: The work rows, top to bottom.

title.description: The row's issue or PR title on GitHub once read, else what the first worker's brief says the work is.

url.description: The PR on GitHub, else the issue.

kind.description: you: waits on the owner, drawn to stand out.

now.description: One sentence: who is on it and what it waits for.

item.description: The open decision or to-do it waits on (D7, T12).

tab.description: The worker whose tab to focus.

mergedAt.description: When the PR merged, in ms since the epoch; null or absent when unknown (older boards).

ciFailure.description: What failed in an open PR's CI, read once per failing head; null or absent when its CI has not failed or nobody knows (older boards). Counts, tests and url may be missing when the log could not be read.

more.description: Failing tests beyond the ones named.

conflictsWith.description: The base branch an open PR conflicts with; null or absent when it doesn't or nobody knows (older boards).

review.description: The newest review of this task from a reviewer's report; null or absent when none (older boards).

blockers.description: A few short lines, empty on approve.

head.description: The commit it reviewed, when the report said.

shares.description: The other open PRs on this board that change the same files, lockfiles aside; absent on older boards.

next.description: The coordinator's Ready list from set_next, in the order it starts; an issue a task already has is left out. Absent on older boards.

key.description: owner/repo#218, or #218 when the repo is unknown.

planned.description: A planner already wrote its plan.

needs.description: What waits on the owner, in its slots; closed ones stay until clearDone.

text.description: The question or the to-do in full.

end.description: How a closed one ended: the answer, done, dismissed.

url.description: A link in a to-do's text (https://…, localhost:5173).

images.description: Optional, so older boards stay valid. Absolute paths of screenshots or recordings to show with an open item.

status.description: The last action's result, or that the PR checks failed.

actions.description: The outcome of the last 10 action files, oldest first.

action.description: One JSON file in <session id>.actions/, named so name order is the order to do them in (e.g. <ms>-<random>.json); write it elsewhere and move it in.

key.description: An open to-do, T12: done for a do, dismissed for a know.

worker.description: A worker's name: as the stop tool does.
A worker's name: as the interrupt tool does, and its coordinator is told.
